STAT 252: Applied Statistics II
Winter Term 2026
University of Alberta

Course Information:
This course covers hypothesis testing, analysis of variance (ANOVA), simple and multiple linear regression, contingency tables, and non-parametric methods with applications using R/RStudio.

Evaluation Scheme:
Your final grade will be calculated using the following grading components:
- Three computer lab assignments (5% each, total 15%)
- Midterm examination (25%)
- Applied data analysis project (15%)
- Final examination (45%)

Deadlines and Important Exam Dates:
- Lab Assignment 1 (ANOVA and Model Assumptions) must be submitted electronically by Friday, January 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM.
- Lab Assignment 2 (Multiple Regression Analysis) is due on Friday, February 13, 2026 at 11:59 PM.
- The in-person Midterm Exam will be administered during regular class hours on Wednesday, March 04, 2026.
- Lab Assignment 3 (Categorical Data Analysis) is due on Friday, March 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM.
- The Data Analysis Project report and code files are due on Friday, April 03, 2026 at 5:00 PM.
- The two-hour Final Exam is scheduled on Friday, April 17, 2026 at 2:00 PM.

Submission Guidelines:
All assignments and reports must be converted to PDF format and uploaded to eClass.
